terbaru.judul: Artificial Life using a Book and Bookmarker
terbaru.pelajaran: This study carefully extracts the characteristics of the cellular automata and Sims models to propose a new artificial life model that can simulate reproduction, development, and individual interactions while exhibiting high expressive power for morphology and behavior.

terbaru.judul: Innovation and informal knowledge exchanges between firms
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose in this paper a stylised agent-based model to test the role of geographical proximity and informal knowledge exchanges between firms on the emergence of innovations.

terbaru.judul: Adapting the Exploration-Exploitation Balance in Heterogeneous Swarms: Tracking Evasive Targets
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we study the effect of a swarm's heterogeneity on its exploration-exploitation balance while tracking multiple fast-moving evasive targets under the Cooperative Multi-Robot Observation of Multiple Moving Targets framework.

terbaru.judul: Emergence of Novelty in Evolutionary Algorithms
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce our approach to the maze problem and compare it to the previously proposed solution, denoted as Novelty Search (Lehman and Stanley, 2011a).

terbaru.judul: Body schema or the body as its own best model
terbaru.pelajaran: Rodney Brooks (1991) put forth the idea that during an agent's interaction with its environment, representations of the world often stand in the way.

terbaru.judul: Design and Simulation of an Autonomous Quantum Flying Robot Vehicle: An IBM Quantum Experience
terbaru.pelajaran: Building upon that, we propose a quantum robot vehicle that is `smart' enough to understand the complex situations more than that of a simple Braitenberg vehicle and navigate itself as per the obstacles present.

terbaru.judul: The Environmental Discontinuity Hypothesis for Down-Sampled Lexicase Selection
terbaru.pelajaran: In our empirical studies, we find that forcing incremental environmental change is not significantly better for evolving solutions to program synthesis problems than simple random down-sampling.

terbaru.judul: An Artificial Neural Network Functionalized by Evolution
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a hybrid model which combines the tensor calculus of feed-forward neural networks with Pseudo-Darwinian mechanisms.

terbaru.judul: Shape Change and Control of Pressure-based Soft Agents
terbaru.pelajaran: Here we propose a novel soft-bodied agents formalism, namely Pressure-based Soft Agents (PSAs): they are bodies of gas enveloped by a chain of springs and masses, with pressure pushing on the masses from inside the body.

terbaru.judul: Sustainably Grown: The Underdog Robots of the Future
terbaru.pelajaran: It is hard to imagine with the progress in robotics that current approaches are lacking somewhere, yet they will not be applicable to the majority of robots in the near future.
